Enugu State has asked the National Sports Commission to postpone the 23rd National Sports Festival from November 26–December 11, 2026, to the first week of May 2027, citing concerns over the readiness of key sporting facilities, PUNCH Sports Extra reports. The request, made by the Enugu State Ministry of Youth and Sports and the Local Organising Committee, followed an assessment of facilities at the Nnamdi Azikiwe Stadium and Awgu Games Village, which organisers said might not be ready to meet the required standards before the scheduled commencement of the Games. The National Sports Commission is yet to confirm whether it will approve the proposed change of dates. In a statement signed by the LOC Media Officer, Brian Okechukwu, on behalf of the committee, the organisers said the decision followed an internal inspection of the facilities to determine their level of readiness for the national sporting event. “Although the contractors handling the projects expressed confidence that the facilities would be completed within the expected timeframe, the Enugu State Ministry of Youth and Sports and the LOC, after a careful assessment, observed that the level of work remaining raised concerns about the readiness of the stadium and Awgu Games Village to meet the required standards before the commencement of the Games,” the statement read. Commissioner for Youth and Sports and LOC Chairman, Lloyd Ikechukwu Ekweremadu, said the proposed postponement would provide sufficient time to complete outstanding work and ensure the facilities meet the required standards. The statement added that the zonal eliminations had been completed, while the state was preparing to move into the closed-camping phase ahead of the festival. Enugu State reiterated its commitment to hosting a successful competition, saying the additional time would allow it to provide adequate facilities, safety standards and effective coordination for athletes, officials and spectators. “The postponement is aimed at ensuring that Enugu State delivers a world-class National Sports Festival characterised by adequate sporting facilities, the highest standards of safety, effective coordination and a memorable experience for athletes, officials, spectators and other stakeholders from across the country,” the statement added.
